import java.util.*;

    static class Modular {
        private final static int MOD = 1000000007;
        private long val;

        public Modular() {
            val = 0;
        }

        public <U> Modular(U v) {
            long temp = ((Number) v).longValue() % MOD;
            if (temp < 0) temp += MOD;
            this.val = temp;
        }

        public static Modular getModular() {
            return new Modular();
        }

        public static Modular getModular(int v) {
            return new Modular(v);
        }

        public <U> Modular pow(U p) {
            long exp = ((Number) p).longValue();
            Modular base = new Modular(this.val);
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public Modular inv() {
            long a = this.val, b = MOD;
            long ax = 1, bx = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                long q = a / b, t = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = t;
                long newAx = bx - q * ax;
                bx = ax;
                ax = newAx;

            if (ax < 0) ax += MOD;
            return new Modular(ax);
        }

        public Modular add(Modular m) {
            long res = this.val + m.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        public Modular subtract(Modular m) {

            return new Modular(res);
        }

        public Modular multiply(Modular m) {
            long res = (this.val * m.val) % MOD;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;

            Modular m = (Modular) o;
            return this.val == m.val;
        }

        public String toString() {
